# Fox raincoat consistency test

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Source reports stable fox, coat and one umbrella but failure to walk past the bus stop: the fox walks in place and turns. Left-paw placement and silver zip cannot be confidently resolved at published sizes. One run per prompt/surface in a small publisher test, not a benchmark. Exact public instructions remain at source; no generations were run. App model must not be inferred from API labels. Offline recovery recheck on 2026-11-08 confirms retained source mapping and original file integrity, not backend execution or current availability.
